tldr: This week the hub and the plugins took most of the tokens, and 14 spring illustrations are done. The sharpest thing: three tasks were set without a "done when..." and came back for rework - about a third of the week's tokens.

insights.title: Tasks without "done when..." were redone
insights.what: "Make prompts for the summer set" (Tue) came back three times: 4.1M tokens, two of the three rounds were about what the result should look like.
insights.try: Add the finish line to the task: "prompts for 5 objects, like the spring box, done when I have picked in the design tool".

insights.title: A form waited for you for four days
insights.what: The question about the cover format sat from Monday to Friday; the session worked on guesses and its 1.8M tokens went to a version you did not want.
insights.try: Answer forms from Telegram on the go, or say "decide yourself" in the task.

insights.title: The hub can hold Telegram quiet
insights.what: This week 23 intermediate messages came to Telegram while you were in meetings.
insights.try: Turn on "Only important" in the Telegram settings: a chain of work then ends with one message.
